ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels in distal regions versus 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central notch region and scattered mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity contiguous blob radiating from the notch, transitioning into high-intensity fields on the lateral lobes. Scattered punctate low-intensity spots are distributed across the high-intensity distal zones, particularly a dense cluster on the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped cleft with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and deep vertical penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire span. A significant macro-indentation (missing pixel mass) is located on the inner margin of the right lobe near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with a concave sweep near the median notch transitioning to a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular clusters with high texture located at both the left and right distal tips and along the anterior leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear streaks; notably several diagonal marks on the mid-left lobe and fine horizontal scratches on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jagged notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe adjacent to the median cleft; heavy crustose texture on tips and leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, isolated dark circular mark located in the central white field of the left lobe.
